scenario: 今天具身赛道的主线是机器人训练数据从哪来，以及动作怎么表示更好用。OpenJaws 把手持采集夹爪的相机换成廉价双目，动作标签的轨迹误差降到几毫米，整套软硬件开源。CARD 把人手示范换算成机器人动作时保住接触和力，SAI 只用一个操作员就教会两台机器人配合。方法上，一篇系统比较发现离散动作并不比连续动作差，TOPS 给流匹配策略按任务换起点，VLA-Stem 不改 VLA 就加上了避障。产业侧，Physical Intelligence 开放了模型微调和推理 API。

papers.title: OpenJaws: An Open Hardware UMI Framework with Stereo Localization for Generalist Manipulation
papers.authors: Adithyavairavan Murali, Yash Oza, Karanbir Chahal, Neel Jawale, Silas De Vries, Hesam Rabeti, Erwin Coumans, Balakumar Sundaralingam, Stan Birchfield
papers.abstract: Handheld data-collection interfaces such as the Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) allow manipulation demonstrations to be gathered in the wild without a robot in the loop, but the quality of the resulting action labels is bounded by the accuracy of vision-based localization. Existing systems recover end-effector pose from monocular visual-inertial odometry, which is subject to scale ambiguity and drift, or delegate tracking to closed-source modules and external infrastructure that reintroduce cost and setup burden. We present OpenJaws, a fully open hardware and software framework for sensorized UMI that improves localization and simplifies deployment across robot platforms. OpenJaws pairs a modular, 3D-printed gripper exposing a standardized ISO adapter with a low-cost stereo camera to recover metric camera trajectories. We further introduce UMI-Loc-Bench-v1, a benchmark quantifying real-world localization accuracy for handheld data-collection devices, and show that stereo localization substantially outperforms monocular alternatives. Finally, we demonstrate that policies trained on data collected with OpenJaws can be deployed on a real robot across multiple tasks. Hardware, software, and data are released under a commercially permissive license. Code, data, and videos are available at https://open-jaws.github.io/
papers.summary: 用手持夹爪（UMI）在野外采机器人示教数据已经很流行，但动作标签准不准，取决于从腕部相机视频里还原夹爪轨迹的那一步。原版 UMI 用单目相机加 IMU（惯性测量单元），单目看不出真实尺度，还要预先建图、贴标记物来稳住。OpenJaws 把相机换成一台百元级的双目相机，两只镜头的间距是标定好的，三角化直接给出真实尺度。在作者新做的带真值评测集上，只比两者都能跟住的片段，双目重建的轨迹误差约 2.9 毫米，原版方案是 18.4 毫米，而且原版平均只跟住 37% 的帧。整套夹爪约 400 美元，软硬件全部开源。

papers.title: Pushing Dexterity and Safety for In-Hand Object Pose Reaching That Works Remarkably Well
papers.authors: Ian Chuang, Hiya Shah, Vamsi Chilamkur, Iman Soltani, Claire Tomlin
papers.abstract: Dexterous manipulation with multi-fingered hands is the next frontier of robotics, yet learned hand skills remain limited to simple grasps or basic repeated motions, such as rotating an object. As robots attempt more demanding in-hand maneuvers, safety, such as not dropping the object, becomes critical, yet it is rarely measured. We study in-hand object pose reaching, a task that demands diverse and difficult grasps: moving an object to almost any position and orientation within reach of the fingers, at any wrist orientation, through long sequences of consecutive goals. We present a recipe for training such policies for a LEAP hand in simulation without human data, built on a range of insights, from diverse resets and goals via generated grasp datasets to an adaptive friction curriculum. With careful system identification, the policies transfer zero-shot to the real hand, using either motion capture or a single wrist-mounted depth camera, and prove remarkably capable and robust. On top of the task policy, we add a learned residual safety filter with adjustable conservativeness, letting us tune the balance between performance and safety and greatly reduce object drops. In 13.3 hours of real-robot evaluation over 4,800 unseen goals across 4 objects and diverse wrist orientations, the state-based policy reaches 95.2% of goals within 2 cm and 0.4 rad, and the filter cuts its drops by 75% while still reaching 91.5% of goals. The policies can also spin a lightbulb held in an arbitrary pose, reach out-of-distribution goals, withstand fast arm motion and perturbations, and, needing only a wrist camera, serve as portable skills such as screwing in a lightbulb. We release the full recipe as a platform for studying performance, reliability, and safety in high-dimensional dexterous systems. Videos and more are available at https://ian-chuang.github.io/dexsafe/.
papers.summary: 多指灵巧手学到的技能大多还停在简单抓取或者原地转物体，稍难一点的手内操作，最常见的失败是把东西掉了，可是以往的工作很少专门统计掉落。这篇让 LEAP 机械手把手里的物体挪到几乎任意位置和朝向，手腕朝向也随机变，而且一个目标接一个目标连续做。主策略完全在仿真里训练，直接迁到真机。真机上 95.2% 的新目标都能准确到达。作者再在冻结的主策略上叠一个小网络，它只看手和物体的状态，用强化学习学会给每步动作加一点修正，奖励是物体不掉、修正越小越好。修正的惩罚权重可以在运行时调，调大就更接近原动作。这样掉落减少 75%，到达率仍有 91.5%。

papers.title: GRAFT: Geometry-Aware Residual Adaptation for Foundation Trackers
papers.authors: Liang Li, Guoyao Zhang, Xingyu Chen, Sikai Wu, Qianyang Wu, Yuhang Lin, Renjing Xu, Mingliang Zhou, Diyun Xiang
papers.abstract: Humanoid behavior foundation models (BFMs) provide reusable whole-body motion priors: given a kinematic reference, they generate coordinated joint commands for motion replay, teleoperation, and VLA control. However, trained primarily on flat-ground motion, BFMs lack an explicit mechanism to adapt foot placement, swing clearance, and contact timing to local terrain. Many terrain-aware BFM approaches address this limitation by retraining or fine-tuning the tracker together with perception, incurring substantial data and computation costs while coupling ordinary tracking to the perception pathway. To bridge this gap, we propose GRAFT, a geometry-aware residual adaptation framework for frozen behavior trackers. GRAFT preserves the BFM parameters and motion-reference interface, while a lightweight adapter adds terrain-conditioned corrections only to lower-body execution targets. The adapter is trained with task and foot-geometry rewards, regularized to suppress unnecessary corrections on flat ground, and distilled from privileged terrain observations to onboard depth. Because the frozen BFM already provides whole-body reference tracking and nominal locomotion, GRAFT reduces terrain learning to a focused execution-adaptation problem. We instantiate the framework on four frozen trackers and evaluate stairs, gaps, and platforms in simulation. We further validate it through real-world deployment on a Unitree G1, where the adapted SONIC tracker traverses terrain with onboard depth and unmodified references.
papers.summary: 人形机器人的行为基础模型（BFM，给一段参考动作就输出全身关节指令的通用跟踪策略）大多在平地动作上训练，碰到台阶、沟和平台就容易摔。常见做法是连同感知一起重训或微调整个模型，成本高，还可能把平地上原有的能力弄坏。小米机器人实验室的 GRAFT 把基础模型完全冻住，只加一个小的适配器，按脚下地形给下半身的执行目标加一点修正，平地上的修正被压到接近零。四个冻结的基础模型在最难的地形上原本几乎都过不去，加上 GRAFT 后，表现最好的从 40 次里成功 3 次升到 39 次。适配器最后只靠机载深度相机就在宇树真机上跑通。

papers.title: VLA-Stem: A Lightweight Safety Mechanism for Vision-Language-Action Models via Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Bojun Zou, Wenhao Yu, Jiaohao Li, Jiaxuan Lin, Guanting Ye, Haohan Geng, Weihao Yu, Yanyong Zhang, Jianmin Ji
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models integrate high-level reasoning with low-level action execution for end-to-end robotic control. However, most VLA models target static manipulation in unconstrained environments, overlooking spatial constraints and dynamic obstacles. Fine-tuning VLAs on obstacle-avoidance data is a straightforward solution, but collecting such data is costly, especially for dynamic scenarios, and may degrade their original task capabilities. To address these limitations, we propose VLA-Stem, a lightweight, reinforcement-learning-based safety mechanism for VLA systems. Without fine-tuning the underlying VLA policy, VLA-Stem converts its action chunks into motion references and uses trajectory-level guidance to preserve their spatial intent while allowing flexible motion and timing adjustments. Conditioned on these references, robot proprioception, and local obstacle information, the Stem policy adaptively modifies execution at inference time, preserving the original task intent while enabling responsive adaptation to spatial constraints and dynamic obstacles. For robust and sample-efficient training, we combine teacher-student distillation with curriculum learning. We evaluate VLA-Stem on reference following, static spatial constraints, and dynamic obstacle avoidance. Across six constrained simulation settings, VLA-Stem achieves 52.8% average collision-free task success versus 23.7% for the strongest safety baseline, while preserving base-policy performance in obstacle-free settings; real-world experiments further show consistent collision reductions under static and dynamic obstacles. These results demonstrate that VLA-Stem couples high-level VLA task intent with rapid, reflex-like responses to immediate physical risks, providing a brainstem-inspired mechanism for robust robot execution.
papers.summary: VLA 模型（看图像、读指令，直接输出机器人动作的大模型）擅长按指令抓取和摆放，但大多是在没有障碍的桌面上训练的，旁边多一个箱子或者有东西移过来，它就会直接撞上去。用避障数据去微调 VLA 最直接，可这种数据很难采，还可能伤到原来的任务能力。VLA-Stem 不动 VLA，只在它后面接一个用强化学习训练的小策略：把 VLA 给出的一段动作当作参考路线，结合机器人自身状态和附近障碍物，实时调整实际执行的轨迹和快慢。在六个有障碍的仿真设置里，既不碰撞又完成任务的比例平均 52.8%，最强的安全基线只有 23.7%，没有障碍时原有成功率基本不掉。

papers.title: TOPS: Reshaping Flow Source and Transport for Multi-Task Robot Manipulation
papers.authors: Tuo An, Chuhao Zhou, Jiahua Dong, Jingliang Li, Jiaqi Bai, Jindou Jia, Jianfei Yang
papers.abstract: Flow-based policies for language-conditioned multi-task manipulation commonly share a single $\textit{Gaussian}$ source prior and a common linear transport path across tasks. However, reliably executing multiple tasks with distinct motion requirements remains challenging for a shared policy. We introduce $\textbf{TOPS}$ ($\textbf{T}$ask-$\textbf{O}$riented $\textbf{P}$riors and $\textbf{S}$chedules), which adapts the flow source prior and interpolation schedule to each task without modifying the network architecture. TOPS first constructs multimodal task sources from reverse-mapped expert action sequences, allowing language instructions to select where generation begins. Guided by source-target covariance mismatch, it then slows the transition toward expert actions early in denoising and accelerates it later along directions requiring expansion. Under a $\textit{Gaussian}$ endpoint model, our analysis shows that this schedule adjustment can lower an upper bound on velocity-prediction risk. Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and CALVIN demonstrate improved performance across in-distribution, perturbation and cross-environment settings, alongside better data efficiency. Using one integration step, TOPS raises LIBERO-10 success from $53.44\%$ to $69.67\%$ compared with ten-step Standard Flow Matching (FM), while reducing inference time to approximately one-sixth of the baseline. TOPS also yields consistent gains when transferred to the large-scale flow-based $π_{0.5}$ policy across all four evaluated settings. Real-world experiments further demonstrate improved task success, including an increase from $20\%$ with standard FM to $80\%$ with TOPS on the upper-drawer opening task.
papers.summary: 用 Flow Matching 生成动作的多任务机器人策略，通常让所有任务都从同一团高斯噪声出发，沿直线路径变成动作。可开抽屉和叠积木的动作差别很大，共用一个起点和路径，很难每个任务都学好。TOPS 不改网络，只改这两样。它把专家动作沿训练好的策略倒推回噪声空间，发现不同任务落在不同区域，于是给每个任务拟合一个起点分布，按语言指令从对应区域开始生成。它还比较起点分布和专家动作在各个方向上散开的程度，专家动作散得更开的方向，生成前期少往目标挪、后期多挪，其余方向照常匀速。在 LIBERO 最难的长任务子集上，只走一步的 TOPS 把成功率从标准 Flow Matching 十步的 53.44% 提到 69.67%。

papers.title: DeCAL: Towards Physically-Grounded Dexterous Vision-Language-Action Models via Contact-Aware Latent Co-Imagination
papers.authors: Yankai Fu, Ning Chen, Junkai Zhao, Heng Zhang, Guocai Yao, Pengwei Wang, Zhongyuan Wang, Shanghang Zhang
papers.abstract: Dexterous manipulation involves contact-rich and fine-grained interactions with the physical world, posing significant challenges for existing vision-language-action (VLA) models due to severe visual occlusions and complex contact dynamics. While recent works have incorporated tactile sensing into robotic manipulation, most approaches still rely on homogeneous multimodal fusion, lacking adaptive tactile integration and explicit modeling of physical dynamics. In this work, we present DeCAL, a physically-grounded dexterous vision-language-action model that unifies understanding, imagination and action generation for contact-rich dexterous manipulation. Built upon a Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architecture, DeCAL leverages specialized experts for each capability while enabling efficient information flow among them. To effectively leverage tactile information, we introduce Adaptive Visuo-Tactile Fusion that dynamically regulates tactile interactions via a contact-aware gating strategy. Furthermore, we propose Visuo-Tactile Latent Co-Imagination to jointly model visual and tactile dynamics, equipping the policy with implicit physical world knowledge. Experimental results show that DeCAL consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance across all tasks, attaining a 71% average success rate and an 83.4% progress success rate, while also demonstrating strong generalization to unseen scenarios.
papers.summary: 灵巧手做接触密集的操作时，手指常常把物体挡住，相机看不清，单靠视觉的 VLA 模型很难把握接触和力度。已有工作开始加入触觉，但多数只是把触觉和视觉特征直接拼在一起，不管当下有没有碰到物体。DeCAL 让触觉按接触情况决定参与多少：没碰到时少用，碰到时多用。它还让模型在出动作之前，在隐空间里一起预测接下来画面和触觉的变化，借此学到一些物理规律。在作者的灵巧手任务上，它的平均成功率达到 71%，在没见过的场景里也保持了较好的表现。

papers.title: CARD: Contact-Anchored Retargeting for Dexterous Manipulation
papers.authors: Cunxi Dai, Botao He, Francois R Hogan, Wei Pan, Rao Fu, Wen-Han Hsieh, Ruoshi Liu, Jitendra Malik, Guanya Shi, Akash Sharma
papers.abstract: Humans are dexterous, but traditional data collection paradigms such as teleoperation, kinesthetic teaching, and wearable exoskeletons force humans to act through the robot embodiment, bottlenecking their dexterity. Retargeting can avoid this. However, existing methods purely translate kinematics and ignore the real-world contact dynamics essential for task success. We present CARD: Contact-Anchored Retargeting for Dexterous Manipulation, a simulator and object-free framework that retargets human demonstrations to robot actions by explicitly preserving contact force targets. CARD unifies human data sources including video, motion capture, and tactile gloves via a shared hand--contact representation and generates explicit contact force targets in addition to kinematics. To maintain these contact targets during hardware open-loop replay, CARD also introduces a tactile tracking controller. For video which does not contain an explicit tactile source, we present Vid-HACO, our video-to-contact model that sets a new state of the art. Across our video, glove, motion-capture data and the GRAB dataset, CARD maintains contact on $43$--$78\%$ of contact frames, while kinematic and object-aware retargeting methods maintain contact on $<10\%$ and $22.5\%$ of the frames respectively. Further, integrating our formulation into physics-based retargeting improves strict task success from 12\% to 32\% on GRAB dataset. Finally, we show that our tactile tracker is critical to reproduce demonstrated forces during hardware replay. These results establish that contact preservation via CARD is a scalable interface for transferring human dexterity to robots.
papers.summary: 教灵巧手最省事的办法，是把人手示范直接换算成机器人动作，即重定向。可现有方法只对齐指尖位置和关节角度，不管手和物体之间有没有接触、用了多大力，机器人手该贴住物体的地方常常没贴住。CARD 先记下每一帧人手哪些位置碰到物体、用了多大力：触觉手套直接读压力，视频没有力的信息，就用作者训练的模型从画面判断哪些位置在接触，每个接触点按同样的力算。重定向时，机器人手除了跟随手指位置，还要在对应位置产生这些接触力。它保住接触的帧数是只对齐运动学方法的好几倍。把这个思路加进基于物理的重定向，在 GRAB 数据集的仿真回放里，物体真被搬过大半程、该抬起时确实抬起才算成功，成功率从 12% 提到 32%。

papers.title: Sequential Asymmetric Imitation for Learning Coupled Robot Policies
papers.authors: Ranpeng Qiu, Yincong Chen, Zihao Li, Yanan Zhou, Guoqiang Ren, Weiming Zhi
papers.abstract: Collaborative mobile manipulation requires robots to coordinate with a partially observed partner while physically interacting through shared objects. This is difficult because failures often arise not from poor local skills, but from mistimed waiting, yielding, pulling, releasing, or repositioning. We study this problem with two bimanual mobile manipulators coupled through rigid and deformable objects. We propose Sequential Asymmetric Imitation (SAI), a single-teleoperator curriculum for learning coupled multi-robot behaviors without synchronized dual-operator demonstrations or explicit inter-robot communication. SAI trains Robot A from unilateral demonstrations with a compliant human partner, trains Robot B against the deployed Robot A policy, and then refines Robot A using sparse interventions near coordination failures. This staged process exposes the policies to increasingly realistic partner behaviors, including delay, phase mismatch, insufficient yielding, and interaction conflict. Across real-world dual-robot manipulation tasks, SAI improves task success, phase synchronization, and partner-contingent yielding over independent imitation and curriculum-ablation baselines. These results suggest that physically coupled collaboration can be learned through the structure of the imitation curriculum, rather than through synchronized multi-operator demonstrations or explicit coordination mechanisms.
papers.summary: 两台移动双臂机器人通过同一个物体协作时，失败往往不是谁的单项技能不行，而是时机没对上：该等的时候没等，该让的时候没让，该松手的时候还在拉。常规做法要两个人同时遥操作采示范，成本高，也很难同步。这篇的 SAI 只要一个操作员，分三步：先由人扮演配合度很高的搭档，教会机器人 A；再让 A 按学到的策略自己动，操作员遥操作 B 跟它配合，采到的示范用来训练 B；最后只在 A 快要配合失败的地方让人插手纠正。这样机器人见到的搭档越来越像真实情况，会有延迟、节奏错位和让得不够。真机实验里，它的成功率、同步程度和让步表现都好于两台各自独立模仿的做法。

papers.title: When Do Discrete Actions Make Good Continuous Controllers?
papers.authors: Zeji Yi, Soham Dasgupta, Xinyang Zhang, Koushil Sreenath, Guannan Qu, Xi Chen, Max Simchowitz, Guanya Shi
papers.abstract: Though modern AI models like LLMs predict discrete tokens, today's robotic foundation models represent actions as continuous vectors. In this paper, we challenge this common consensus by asking if continuous action parametrizations are superior to their discrete counterparts. We conduct an extensive comparison of single-step regression and multi-step flow variants of both continuous and discrete policies in both from-scratch single-task and multi-task VLA training, in both simulation and on real hardware. In all regimes, we find that discrete action prediction, even the most naive, uniform-bin quantization, can match or even outperform continuous-action policies in task success rate. Moreover, we find that the challenge to discrete action policies is not action precision, but rather factorization error introduced by product-distribution predictions across time and action dimensions. We show that, when paired with the correct interventions (iterative computation through discrete flows, or distribution sharpening through classifier-free guidance), discrete flow policies can turn this weakness into a strength, enabling more responsive action changes during a predicted action chunk. Lastly, we show that attempts to explicitly inject geometric information into discrete policies, e.g. through corruption processes that emulate continuous flow matching, do not yield consistent improvements. Taken together, our findings question existing assumptions that robotic action prediction requires distinct design decisions compared to other AI domains, and motivate the possibility of discrete action prediction as a compelling alternative to today's continuous action parametrizations. Project page: https://iscoyizj.github.io/discrete-action-website/
papers.summary: 大模型都在预测离散 token，机器人基础模型却几乎都把动作当连续向量来预测，默认的理由是离散化会损失精度。这篇在仿真和真机、单任务和多任务 VLA 上系统比了一遍，发现最朴素的离散做法，把每个动作维度均匀切成若干档，成功率也能追平甚至超过连续动作。离散策略真正的问题不在精度，而在于各个时间步、各个维度分开预测，拼起来可能是互相矛盾的组合。借用扩散模型里的无分类器引导，放大有观测和没观测两次预测的差别，让每个动作维度的概率集中到少数几档上，档位划分不变。这样做后，离散回归在 RoboCasa 上的成功率从 27.1% 升到 49.2%，接近多步迭代生成的离散流匹配的 53.9%。机器人动作未必需要和其他 AI 领域不同的表示。

papers.title: Frontier Models for Every Robot: Announcing our API beta
papers.abstract: We are making our latest models available for training and inference through the Pi API beta. You upload data, launch fine-tuning on compute and infrastructure we manage, and access fine-tuned models via a hosted gateway to run inference. Actor deploys autonomous heavy machinery. Their autonomous wheel loader scoops material and loads it into a dump truck during a real commercial deployment without any operator inside the machine.
papers.summary: Physical Intelligence 把自家最新的机器人基础模型开放成了 API 测试版：开发者上传示范数据，在它托管的算力上微调 π 系列模型，再通过云端推理直接控制自己的机器人。早期用户覆盖了不少行业，有在真实商业现场无人驾驶装载机装车的，也有用 API 迭代四天，就让双臂机器人给自己的零件去毛刺的。官方总结的共同经验是，改进流程大同小异：采示范、训模型、上机测试，再根据失败决定下一批采什么数据。部分用户遇到了网络问题，云端推理对现场网络有要求。对做机器人应用的团队来说，这意味着不必自建训练基础设施就能用上前沿模型，但数据和失败分析仍要自己做。
